scope: Review-only inspection of two blinded child-facing evaluation candidates (Candidate A, Candidate B) derived from academic contract 274c49ed00318c3c5e7eb4fae53bfbbea61645b4488f4b88780ba9cb431b7361. Evidence limited to one intro-screen screenshot per candidate at 1365×768 and blinded machine diagnostics (title, visible text, control count, document/viewport dimensions, console/page errors). No interaction traces, event logs, or post-Start screens were provided.

limitations: Only one static intro-screen screenshot per candidate was provided; no question screens, interaction traces, or recordings, so control responsiveness, state-change comprehensibility, incorrect/uncertain-response continuation behavior, and mathematical control of the interaction could not be directly observed for either candidate.
No emitted event logs or event schemas were provided; preservation of independent/assisted/exposed/ambiguous/friction evidence classification could not be assessed.

The immutable academic contract content was not provided (only its hash), so conformance and non-modification could only be checked against surface indicators (e.g., question count vs. progress dots).

Candidate design hashes in the architect-call metadata were listed as 'injected_after_frozen_architect_call', preventing independent verification that the supplied candidate hashes correspond to designs frozen before this review.
Diagnostics reflect load-time state only; runtime console/page errors after interaction are unknown.
Candidate B diagnostics visibleText contains leading blank lines whose source elements are not identifiable from the screenshot; this is noted but unexplained.
All observations are limited to the 1365×768 viewport; behavior at other resolutions was not evaluated.
